# Apple’s romantic AI-companion rating change has staged declaration dates


By OpenTools Team


New descriptors arrive November 16, followed by declarations on update and an all‑app January 12 deadline.


##


Feature scope


Apple’s[November 2 announcement](https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=yxkh08us) puts virtual companions offering sexual or romantic content within Dating and Relationships, a category receiving a minimum 18+ rating. The test is the feature’s content, rather than whether an app uses AI. Shared Location is a separate descriptor with region‑dependent rating effects.


##


Declaration timing


The descriptors arrive in App Store Connect on November 16, 2026. Developers must then declare features when submitting updates or changing the rating questionnaire; all apps must complete declarations by January 12, 2027. January 12 does not let an earlier update bypass the questionnaire.[Apple also describes](https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=yxkh08us) a way to request an official lower rating in Brazil for apps believed eligible.
